initial: A at 0, both incoming directions R, sheet localized at zero; B specified for each run. Only the binary A port is read, at tick three. Earlier tables are computed without intervening measurements.
exact_readout: A=(1,R) gives probability 1/4 for B=8, 1/2 for B=16; complements 3/4 and 1/2. A=(-1,L) gives 1/4 versus 0. Four other reachable A ports each have mass 1/8.
scope: The distinguishing initial states are localized with the same ancillary preparation. A radius-one physical circuit cannot distinguish either B input at the A port in three layers. The shared-sheet transport is a joint rule on configurations. The cone conclusion requires a local ring encoding of input, output, clock and independent ancillas. The finite values are not a continuum or empirical measurement.

arbitrary_initial_sheet.formula: At B=8 the A=(1,R) POVM on any initial sheet density is (16I+8T+8T^{-1})/64. At B=16 it is 32I/64. Evaluating the first on character k gives (1+cos(2 pi k/17))/4. This assumes the same initially localized bases and a sheet uncorrelated with remote preparation.
